ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly low-intensity (black/dark-grey) background with an estimated 3-5% high-intensity pixel coverage concentrated in punctate white speckling.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Stochastic distribution of white punctate markers (1-5 pixel diameter) across both lobes; localized high-intensity cluster of 5-6 circular blobs at the distal terminus of the left lobe.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped central depression with a calculated interior angle of approximately 74 degrees.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency irregular serrations along the trailing edges of both lobes, with pixel-amplitude variations between 2 and 12 pixels; notable protrusions on the distal left margin.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex curve originating from the median notch, flattening toward the mid-lobe, and exhibiting a slight concave sweep at the distal extremities.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Distinct cluster of approximately five circular white high-contrast pixel groups located at the extreme left fluke tip; additional isolated white circular marks scattered on the medial fluke surfaces.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Single horizontal white linear pixel disruption approximately 80 pixels long located on the inner left lobe, positioned 20 pixels superior to the notch apex.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Localized white barnacle-like clusters at the left fluke tip and a horizontal linear scratch on the inner left lobe.
other_distinctive_markers: Dense, uniform white speckling pattern across the dark pigmentation of both fluke lobes.
